# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` as the repository-maintenance contract. For software engineering tasks, use `skills/senior-software-engineer/SKILL.md` and only the internal references relevant to the task. The repository registers and enables the master plugin through `.github/copilot/settings.json`. Preserve the single-master-skill architecture, protect user changes and secrets, validate with real project commands and report evidence honestly.
